name: Hanafuda Club
source:
What do you get when you mix three beautiful college girls, a perverted sexually-focused fairy, and a Japanese-Hawaiian card game? Hanafuda Club! Lemma (the site mascot) and Gaji (the hanafuda fairy) introduce you to the Hanafuda Club characters and the world of hanafuda in this demo. It even has a... "Special Ending"~

The demo has been published but the full game is presumably abandoned.

[From [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20110317080609/http://www.lemmasoft.net:80/games_hanafudaclub.html]lemmasoft page[/url]]
